camel_example: aliyun alidns SearchRecursionZones --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy default --ZoneName 'cheng.suow.cc' --PageSize 5 --NextToken 4698691 --PageNumber 1 --EffectiveScopes '[{"EffectiveType":"account","Scope":["20003"]}]' --MaxResults 50 --Direction asc --Remark test
description_en: Searches for zones of built-in authoritative domain names used for recursive resolution
description_zh: 搜索递归解析内置权威域名zone
kebab_example: aliyun alidns search-recursion-zones --zone-name cheng.suow.cc --remark test --page-number 1 --page-size 5 --effective-scopes '[{"EffectiveType":"account","Scope":["20003"]}]' --order-by default --direction asc --max-results 50 --next-token 4698691 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchRecursionZones

parameters.help_en: The remark for the zone. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地址池备注，支持对输入的备注进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start at 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The type of the effective scope. Valid value: `account`
fields.help_zh:
生效范围类型
account: 账户
fields.name: effective_type

fields.help_en: A list of scope values that correspond to the specified `EffectiveType`. For example, if `EffectiveType` is set to `account`, this parameter contains a list of account IDs for users that use recursive resolution
fields.help_zh: 生效范围列表，与生效类型对应 account类型对应递归解析用户的accountid列表
fields.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Valid values: `UpdateTime`: the update time of the zone. `RecordCount`: the number of DNS records
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，结果按哪个字段进行排序
UpdateTime：修改时间
RecordCount：解析记录条数
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: `asc`: ascending. `desc`: descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向
asc:升序
desc:降序
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token
